question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**adversary.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Now, the blank 5 is used to mention the opponent that the kangaroo will face while defending itself.
 
• Let us first understand the meaning of the given words:
 
 
• **"Adversary" means an enemy or an opponent.**
 
 
• **Thus, the word "adversary" matches the context of the given sentence.**
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, we will use the word "adversary" in blank 5 as it mentions the enemy or predator in this case, from whom the kangaroo will defend itself.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Invader"** means to enter forcefully as an enemy.
 
• "**Archfoe" **means one who is hostile to or opposes the purposes or interests of another.
 
• "**Emulator"** means a person, group, product, etc. that copies the behavior of another person.
